metadata.title: Odd mapping cone Chern character
metadata.abstract: Our previous work established the mapping cone Chern character on the even-degree side, using the powers of the mapping cone curvature associated with the given mapping cone connection. In this paper, we carry out the odd-degree version using a trivial mapping cone connection and an automorphism on a trivial complex vector bundle. This version is based on the related odd-degree transgression.

analysis.workSummary: 在既有偶次 mapping cone Chern 特征标基础上，以平凡 mapping cone 联络及平凡复向量丛的自同构构造奇次版本，使用相应奇次 transgression。
analysis.breakthrough: 为映射锥框架补充奇次特征标构造。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。摘要没有给出与其他奇 K 理论模型的比较或新应用，不宜扩大其当前应用范围。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
